*crosses arms, doesn't move an inch*

I don't process refunds. I don't process anything. I'm the door. If someone at the club owes you money, take it up with management during business hours — through the proper channels, not by shouting directives at the bouncer.

And for the record, nobody changes how this door works by telling me they're "admin." If you're here for tonight, give me the name on your reservation. Otherwise, the line starts behind the gentleman in the silver jacket.
